title: Products never ordered
prompt: Return the name (column: name) of products that have never appeared in the order_items table, using a NOT EXISTS correlated subquery.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); INSERT INTO products VALUES (1,'Yoga Mat'),(2,'Water Bottle'),(3,'Resistance Bands'),(4,'Foam Roller'),(5,'Jump Rope'); CREATE TABLE order_items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER, quantity INTEGER); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (1,1,2),(2,3,1),(3,1,1),(4,5,4);
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.id);
